boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission, no-purchase places and activities for Macalester students around Saint Paul.

cards.title: See contemporary work at Law Warschaw Gallery
cards.subtitle: Janet Wallace Fine Arts Center, Macalester College
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s current exhibition, then use the public entrance doorbell at the northeast corner of the gallery block.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery visit that is free and open to the public when programming is running.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester states that Law Warschaw Gallery programming is free and open to the public, except on Mondays when it is closed.
cards.access_notes: Closed Mondays; the official page asks off-campus visitors to use the northeast-corner doorbell.

cards.title: Claim a study-room conversation
cards.subtitle: Merriam Park Library, 1831 Marshall Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve a small study room for a focused catch-up, or ask at the desk for a walk-in room when one is available.
cards.short_summary: A free, bookable small-group space with walk-in availability when unoccupied.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Public Library lists study rooms at Merriam Park as free of charge and allows walk-ins when a room is available.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms may be reserved from 24 hours to 14 days ahead; walk-ins are first-come, first-served when available.

cards.title: Wander Mia’s permanent collection
cards.subtitle: 2400 Third Avenue South, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Walk into the permanent-collection galleries together and save special exhibitions or ticketed events for another day.
cards.short_summary: General admission provides a no-ticket route through Mia’s permanent collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Mia says general admission to its permanent collection is always free and requires neither tickets nor reservations.
cards.source_title: Visit the Minneapolis Institute of Art—Always Free
cards.access_notes: Free access covers the permanent collection; special exhibitions and select events can require tickets and fees.

cards.title: Take a sculpture-garden loop
cards.subtitle: Walker Art Center campus, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Meet by Spoonbridge and Cherry, then follow the outdoor paths through the garden’s more than 60 sculptures.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor art-and-walk hang with no ticket needed.
cards.evidence_claim: Walker Art Center states that the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden is free to the public, requires no tickets, and is open daily.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are daily, 6 a.m.–midnight, year-round; check the page for closures or conditions.

cards.title: Visit Como Park Zoo
cards.subtitle: 1225 Estabrook Drive, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the visitor map to choose a few animal areas, and skip the optional donation kiosk if you are keeping the outing free.
cards.short_summary: A public zoo visit where admission is free and donations are optional.
cards.evidence_claim: Como states that admission to Como Park Zoo is free and visitors are welcome whether or not they make a voluntary donation.
cards.source_title: Como Park Zoo & Conservatory: Visitor Map & Hours
cards.access_notes: Hours vary seasonally: 10 a.m.–6 p.m. May 1 through Labor Day and 10 a.m.–4 p.m. otherwise.

cards.title: Warm up in the Marjorie McNeely Conservatory
cards.subtitle: Como Park Zoo & Conservatory, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Walk the conservatory displays at your own pace and treat the suggested donation as optional rather than part of admission.
cards.short_summary: A year-round indoor plant outing with voluntary, not required, donations.
cards.evidence_claim: Como states that admission to the Marjorie McNeely Conservatory is free and visitors are welcome without making a donation.
cards.source_title: Como Park Zoo & Conservatory: Visitor Map & Hours
cards.access_notes: Hours vary seasonally: 10 a.m.–6 p.m. May 1 through Labor Day and 10 a.m.–4 p.m. otherwise.

cards.title: Meet at Phalen Regional Park Beach
cards.subtitle: Phalen Regional Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the sand beach, splash pad, picnic area, or paved loop; bring what you need and avoid paid watercraft rentals.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal beach-and-park outing with free entry and parking.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul identifies Phalen Park Beach as a family-friendly destination with free admission and free parking.
cards.access_notes: This is seasonal; city information lists swimming-beach amenities and notes separate watercraft rentals.

cards.title: Browse the Minnesota Museum of American Art
cards.subtitle: Historic Pioneer Endicott, downtown Saint Paul
cards.notes: Plan a daytime gallery stop around the current exhibition schedule, and use the museum’s free admission instead of a ticketed event.
cards.short_summary: Downtown Saint Paul art viewing with free admission and free monthly tours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Minnesota Museum of American Art lists free admission and regular Thursday–Sunday public hours.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Thursday–Sunday hours, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm exhibition and holiday details before going.

cards.entity_name: The Smallest Museum in St. Paul
cards.title: Stop for a tiny public-art exhibit
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Build a short walk around the current window-scale exhibit, then spend a few minutes comparing what each person notices first.
cards.short_summary: An all-year, no-admission public-art stop designed for brief visits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smallest Museum in St. Paul says there is no admission fee, anyone can visit, and it is open year-round.
cards.source_title: About the Smallest Museum in St. Paul
cards.access_notes: The museum describes itself as open year-round; its exhibits are on the University Avenue corridor.

cards.title: Use Free Thursday Night at the History Center
cards.subtitle: Minnesota History Center, 345 West Kellogg Boulevard
cards.notes: Go Thursday between 4 and 8 p.m. for the recurring free-admission window, then explore exhibits without buying a general ticket.
cards.short_summary: A weekly evening option that includes both museum admission and parking at no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Minnesota Historical Society states that Thursday-night visits from 4–8 p.m. receive free admission and parking at the Minnesota History Center.
cards.access_notes: Free Thursday Night runs 4–8 p.m.; verify the current Thursday schedule and any special closures before travel.
